serverInfo.name: signedby
serverInfo.title: SignedBy
serverInfo.description: Send and manage e-signature requests, and seal finished documents with a Verified Badge, on SignedBy. Every document still requires the human signer to open the link and sign it themselves -- this server can trigger a send, it can never sign on anyone's behalf.

auth.description: Requires a SignedBy API key (generated from Settings -> Integration & API) on the Pro plan or higher, passed as 'Authorization: Bearer sb_live_...'.
